description: WinAurex System, Kernel & Gaming Tweaks Catalog

tweaks.Title: Foreground Quantum Optimization (Win32PrioritySeparation)
tweaks.Description: Allocates 3x thread time quantum to foreground active window to eliminate frame stutter.

tweaks.Title: Dedicate Full CPU to Multimedia & Games
tweaks.Description: Sets background CPU reservation to 0% during multimedia and gaming tasks.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Dedicates 100% of CPU cycles to the active game instead of reserving 20% for background services.

tweaks.Title: Disable Multimedia Network Packet Throttling
tweaks.Description: Disables network packet throttling during gaming and multimedia playback.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Reduces network jitter and packet queuing latency during gaming.

tweaks.Title: Disable Background Game DVR Recording
tweaks.Description: Disables background video capture buffer in Windows Game Bar.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Reclaims 5-15% GPU frame time and eliminates background video encoder thrash.

tweaks.Title: Lock Kernel & Drivers in Physical RAM
tweaks.Description: Prevents Windows executive and device drivers from paging to disk.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Improves DPC driver latency and instantaneous responsiveness on PCs with >= 16GB RAM.

tweaks.Title: Disable Peer-to-Peer Update Seeding
tweaks.Description: Restricts Windows Update Delivery Optimization to HTTP only, blocking peer seeding.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Stops background upload bandwidth consumption and background disk reads.

tweaks.Title: Disable Advertising ID Tracking
tweaks.Description: Disables unique user advertising identifier across modern Windows applications.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Prevents profiling of application usage for targeted advertising.

tweaks.Title: Eliminate Context Menu Show Delay
tweaks.Description: Reduces artificial 400ms delay on context menus to 0ms for instant UI display.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Makes context menus and sub-menus appear instantaneously.

tweaks.Title: Disable Power Throttling on AC Power
tweaks.Description: Disables EcoQoS power throttling for active foreground threads on desktop/AC systems.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Prevents Windows from down-clocking performance cores during intense gaming.

tweaks.Title: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
tweaks.Description: Enables Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling to offload frame scheduling to GPU.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Reduces CPU render-thread latency and improves frame consistency.

tweaks.Title: Disable Windows Diagnostic Data Collection
tweaks.Description: Sets group policy to restrict Windows diagnostic data collection to security level.

tweaks.Title: Disable Tailored Experiences with Diagnostic Data
tweaks.Description: Stops Microsoft from offering tailored recommendations based on diagnostic data.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Blocks diagnostic behavioral tracking and personalized suggestions.

tweaks.Title: Disable Cortana Voice Assistant
tweaks.Description: Disables Cortana policy and speech assistant integration.

tweaks.Title: Disable Bing Suggestions in Windows Search
tweaks.Description: Prevents Windows Search from querying Bing web search suggestions.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Stops search keystroke transmission to Bing servers and speeds up local search.

tweaks.Title: Disable Window Animation Effects
tweaks.Description: Disables window minimize and restore animations for instant window rendering.
tweaks.EstimatedBenefit: Improves window responsiveness on budget hardware.
